display_name_zh: 突变事件—CRISPR基因依赖双向分析

mutation_to_target.meaning: fix one mutation event and rank retained dependency targets

target_to_mutation.meaning: fix one dependency target and rank retained mutation events

pair.meaning: return retained evidence for one directed mutation-target pair

ambiguity_rules.hotspot_gene: Distinguish a Hotspot mutation event from a user-selected dependency target gene.
ambiguity_rules.mutation_without_event_definition: Report available Damaging, Hotspot, and AnySelected counts before choosing a functional event.
ambiguity_rules.direction_without_roles: Identify which entity is the mutation event and which is the CRISPR dependency target.

metric_rules.CRISPRGeneDependency: positive mutant-minus-control difference means mutant models are more dependent
metric_rules.CRISPRGeneEffect: negative mutant-minus-control difference means mutant models are more dependent

interpretation: The two directions are row and column queries of one directed mutation-event by dependency-target association matrix. Results are observational candidates, not causal or experimentally validated synthetic lethality.
